text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
People are passing through the streets of Landosol.
In the middle of the crowd, Daigo was there.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ランドソルの街中を行き交う人々。
その雑踏の中に、ダイゴの姿があった。

text_block_list.name: Daigo
text_block_list.text: Tch... Things are calmer around here than I thought. If there'd been more commotion, I wouldn't have to bother with looking for a fight. I guess the Knights and their sort are doing their jobs.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちっ……
この辺も、
思ったより落ち着いてやがるなぁ。
もっと騒ぎになってりゃ、
ケンカ相手に困らねぇのによ。
騎士団やらなんやらがうまく収めてるってことか。

text_block_list.name: Daigo
text_block_list.text: Well, if I don't got someone to kill time with, then there's no helping it. Not much reason to stay here-
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
暇つぶしの相手がいねぇなら仕方ねぇ。
長居する理由も──

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Hey, Daikon-san!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おーいっ、
ダイコンさ～ん！！！

text_block_list.name: Daigo
text_block_list.text: It's Daigo!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ダイゴだ！！

text_block_list.name: Daigo
text_block_list.text: Well look who it is! What the hell are you doing here?
text_block_list.orig_text:
誰かと思えばテメェかよ！
こんなとこで何やってんだ？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: I'm showing her around the city of Landosol!
text_block_list.orig_text: ランドソルの街を案内してるんだー！

text_block_list.name: Daigo
text_block_list.text:
Heh, helping people as usual, huh?
I don't know who you're showing around, but...
text_block_list.orig_text:
へぇ、
相変わらずの人助けか。
どこのどいつを案内してるか知らねぇが──

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text:
Hold on, Hiyori-chan!
You have to call him by his proper name, okay?
That guy isn't Daikon-san, but Daikoku-san♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
おっとっと、
ヒヨリちゃん！
人の名前はちゃんと呼んであげないとダメだよ～？
その人はダイコンさんじゃなくて、
ダイコクさんでしょ♪

text_block_list.name: Daigo
text_block_list.text: I told you, it's Daigo!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ダイゴだっつってんだろォ！！

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, sorry!
I was just going through the motions like always♪ Ahahaha!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ごめんごめん！
いつものノリでつい♪
あはははは！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: I see, so you knew about him too Aira? About Dango-san?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そっか、
やっぱりアイラも知ってたんだね？
ダンゴさんのこと。

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I guess♪
text_block_list.orig_text: まーね♪

text_block_list.name: Daigo
text_block_list.text:
Why are the nuisances multiplying...!!?
Listen up! My name is Daigo, DA-I-GO!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんで面倒なヤツが増えてんだよ……！！
いいか！？
オレ様の名前はダイゴだ、
ダ・
イ・
ゴ！！

text_block_list.name: Daigo
text_block_list.text:
No, that doesn't matter now.
...What the hell are you? I can tell even at a glance.
You're damn strong.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
んなことはどうでもいい。
……テメェ何モンだ？
一目見りゃ分かる。
相当強ぇだろ。

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text:
Well, pretty much?
If you want to know who I really am, then...
After a spar, I guess.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まー相当ね？
あたしの正体が知りたいんなら……
勝負の後で、
かな。

text_block_list.name: Daigo
text_block_list.text:
Even better.
I don't really give a damn about who you are, but...
As long as you can put up a fight, it's all good!
text_block_list.orig_text:
上等じゃねぇか。
テメェの正体にはそれほど興味はねえが……
ケンカできるんなら、
それでいいぜ！

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text:
Let's see~
 true identity is a pretty long story, but I'll start with the origins of the world...
text_block_list.orig_text:
え～っと
あたしの正体について話すと長くなるんだけど
まずは世界の成り立ちから……

text_block_list.name: Daigo
text_block_list.text:
You're just gonna talk anyway!?
What's with this woman, going at her own damn pace!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
結局話すのかよ！
なんなんだこのマイペース女は！！

text_block_list.name: Daigo
text_block_list.text:
"Another me from a Replica World", huh?
Frankly, it sounds like you're full of it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
『複製の世界』から来たもう一人の自分、
か。
正直眉唾モンな話だが……

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's hard to believe all of a sudden, isn't it?
Especially since I look more like Hiyori-chan's big sister, don't I?
text_block_list.orig_text:
まー急には信じられないよね？
あたし、
ヒヨリちゃんよりお姉さんな感じだし？

text_block_list.name: Daigo
text_block_list.text:
That's not true. Looking at you two like this, it checks out.
You guys may look different at first glance, but I get the feeling you're pretty similar at heart.
text_block_list.orig_text:
んなこたねぇよ。
こうして見てりゃ納得するぜ。
ぱっと見は違っても、
ノリやらなんやら
根っこの部分が似てる気がするしな。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, right!? I was surprised at first, too, but...
We became friends right away♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへ、
だよね！
あたしも最初はびっくりしたけど……
すぐに仲良しになれたんだ♪

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text:
We had a good feeling about each other♪
Not very shocking, huh? I'm still her big sister though~
text_block_list.orig_text:
フィーリングが合うんだよねー♪
ま
、
もちろん？
あたしの方がお姉さんだけどね～

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Huh~ You think so?
But Aira was really excited too, wasn't she?
She wouldn't budge from the front of that food stall!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え～
そうかなぁ？
でも、
アイラだってすごいはしゃいでたよね？
さっきなんか、
全然屋台の前から動かなかったし！

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: No, no, walking around while eating is the best part of traveling, isn't it? Don't worry about calories or budget, and just let loose... I guess?
text_block_list.orig_text:
いやいや、
食べ歩きは旅の醍醐味でしょ？
カロリーとか予算とか気にしないで
ちょ～っと羽目を外しちゃおう……
的な？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
See now, that kind of self-serving attitude!
That's childish behavior, not something an adult would do, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それそれ、
そういう自分に甘いところ！
それって
大人じゃなくて子どもっぽいよ？

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: Owowow! That's a sore spot for your big sis'...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あいたたた！
それはお姉さんの痛いところをグッサグサ……！

text_block_list.name: Daigo
text_block_list.text:
...So, what did you guys come here for?
Didn't you come here because you wanted to talk to me...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……で、
結局テメェら何しに来たんだよ。
俺に用があって声かけたんじゃ……

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: Hey, Hiyori-chan? Being able to spoil yourself every now and then is one of the good things about being an adult, you know? It's true!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いーい、
ヒヨリちゃん？
自分を甘やかせるようになるのが
オトナのいいところでもあるんだよ？　
コレ、
ホント！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Huh, is that right?
I feel like I always see you with rice sauce on your cheeks, Aira...
text_block_list.orig_text:
えー
そうかなぁ？
アイラ、
よくほっぺたにごはんのソースとかつけてる気がするけど……

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: Owowowow! Actually, that's another sore spot...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あいたたた！
実はそこも痛いところ……！

text_block_list.name: Daigo
text_block_list.text: ...Uhh, I should get going. Play nice, you two.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あー、
俺はそろそろ行くわ。
二人とも仲良くな。

text_block_list.name: Aira & Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Wait a minute, Daimon-san!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ちょっと待ってよダイモンさん！！

text_block_list.name: Daigo
text_block_list.text:
It's Daigo!!
Don't screw around with me!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ダイゴだ！！
ハモってんじゃねーよテメェら！！！
